title: The Unbuilt Slope Where Climbing Denies Itself

features.name: expedition denial
features.desc-on-touch: The other expedition's records insist the slope was never constructed. Their instruments agree; their measurements contradict the climb you just made. Both are true, both are here.

features.name: shimmer refutation
features.desc-on-touch: The slope flickers between existing and not. The farther side insists on its own unbeing. This is not damage; this is the slope learning to hold two contradictions about itself at once.

features.name: counter-gradient marker
features.desc-on-touch: Every step you take registers two elevations: the one your body climbs, and the one the other expedition's instruments say does not exist. The archive is learning to map disagreement as geography.

features.name: alternative path-memory
features.desc-on-touch: This path was never walked by the other expedition because the slope was never there. Yet the path remembers the walking. The archive stores the memory of journeys that could not have happened.

features.name: testimony contradiction
features.desc-on-touch: Both expeditions are correct. One climbed here. One never arrived. The slope holds their disagreement about itself as architecture.
